[SWS_CORE_01096] swap overload for Optional
⌈
There shall be an
overload of the swap function within the namespace ara::core for arguments of
type Optional. Its interface shall be equivalent to:
template <typename T>
void swap(Optional<T>& lhs, Optional<T>& rhs);
This function shall exchange the state of lhs with that of rhs.
